_note: Chef-authored map from a SYSTEM COMPENDIUM name to the register name that covers it. Used only by tools/verify-against-compendium.mjs to silence a difference someone has read and settled. Keys are case/punctuation-folded (lowercase, alphanumeric only). Never guessed by a tool.
_renames: The pack carries an ACKS I name the Revised Rulebook replaced. Each was settled by searching the RR for both spellings: the old name does not appear in it and the new one does.
_thiefSkills: The pack ships the ACKS I thief-skill names as class-ability items. The Revised Rulebook's own table names the eight skills Climbing, Hiding, Listening, Lockpicking, Pickpocketing, Searching, Sneaking and Trapbreaking, which is what the register carries as kind.skill; Trapbreaking is the one that both finds and removes.
_splits: The pack enumerates one item per discipline or style where the register carries a single entry whose picks record which one. The tool already folds a 'Craft: Bowyer' prefix to 'Craft'; these map that fold's result onto the register's actual entry name.
